## Overview

Clinical, behavioral, educational, and medical researchers routinely analyze
rich unstructured text—therapy progress notes, EMA journals, student writing,
and patient narratives—that **cannot be transmitted to external cloud LLM APIs**
under IRB, HIPAA, or FERPA data-use agreements.

`airgapllm` provides a complete, privacy-first R workbench for **verifiably
offline local LLM workflows**:

1. **Air-Gapped Container Lifecycle Manager**: Generate pinned, hardened Docker
   (`--network none`, `--read-only`, `--cap-drop ALL`) and HPC Apptainer `.def`
   configurations for `Ollama`, `llama.cpp`, and `vLLM`, verify local model
   weight SHA-256 digests, and run automated pre-flight isolation checks.
2. **Pre-Inference Privacy & PII Engine**: Detect, redact, or reversibly
   pseudonymize (HMAC-SHA256 + AES-256-CBC encrypted vault) direct identifiers
   in pure R before any text reaches the model.
3. **Crash-Resumable Schema-Enforced Batch Extractor**: Extract strictly typed
   tibbles from R data frames with automated repair retries for malformed
   outputs and atomic per-row JSONL checkpointing.
4. **Immutable Audit Trail & IRB Protocol Generator**: Maintain tamper-evident
   SHA-256 hash-chained JSONL logs (strictly barring raw text/PII) and generate
   ready-to-paste IRB/HIPAA Methods boilerplate.

Everything in this vignette runs 100% offline using the built-in deterministic
`runtime_mock()`, while producing the exact container configurations, schemas,
checkpoints, audit logs, and IRB narratives used in production on local GPU
workstations and HPC nodes.

```{r load}
library(airgapllm)
library(tibble)
```

## Step 1: Define a Hardened Air-Gapped Container Specification

Pin your local inference container by exact SHA-256 image digest and local
model weight digest:

```{r container-spec}
# Create a synthetic local GGUF model weight file for this demonstration
tmp_dir <- tempfile("airgap_models_")
dir.create(tmp_dir)
model_file <- file.path(tmp_dir, "llama-3.1-8b-instruct-q4_K_M.gguf")
writeBin(charToRaw("demo-local-open-weights-binary-v1"), model_file)

# Compute and verify streaming SHA-256 digest of the local weights
model_ver <- verify_model_digest(model_file)
model_ver

# Define a hardened, digest-pinned container spec
spec <- airgap_container_spec(
  backend = "llama.cpp",
  image = "ghcr.io/ggerganov/llama.cpp",
  image_digest = paste0("sha256:", strrep("a", 64)),
  model_dir = tmp_dir,
  model_file = basename(model_file),
  model_digest = model_ver$actual_digest,
  gpu = "nvidia",
  memory_limit = "24g",
  user = "1000:1000"
)
spec
```

Generate reproducible deployment artifacts for either a lab workstation
(`emit_docker_run()`, `emit_docker_compose()`) or a university HPC GPU cluster
(`emit_apptainer_def()`):

```{r emit-configs}
cat(emit_docker_run(spec), "\n")
```

```{r emit-apptainer}
cat(emit_apptainer_def(spec), "\n")
```

Run an automated pre-flight isolation and weight-integrity check before
touching any participant data:

```{r preflight}
pf <- preflight_isolation_check(
  spec = spec,
  endpoint = "http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1",
  model_path = model_file
)
pf
```

Notice that any attempt to connect to a remote cloud API or non-loopback host
is rejected immediately:

```{r remote-rejected}
is_loopback_endpoint("http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1")
is_loopback_endpoint("https://api.openai.com/v1")
```

## Step 2: Inspect Pre-Run PII Coverage

Consider a small synthetic batch of clinical session notes containing direct
identifiers:

```{r sample-data}
notes <- tibble(
  note_id = sprintf("NOTE_%02d", 1:6),
  note_text = c(
    "Patient: Jane Doe (MRN: 884210) reported mild sleep disruption on 2026-03-14.",
    "Dr. Robert Vance emailed follow-up plan to jane.doe@clinic.org; anxiety reduced.",
    "Emergency contact phone (555) 234-5678 verified; no acute crisis indicators.",
    "DOB: 1989-11-02; lives at 742 Evergreen Terrace, Hartford, CT 06103. Mood stable.",
    "Student ID: STU-44102 completed coping exercises after Cognitive Behavioral Therapy.",
    "Progress note with zero personal identifiers; affect calm and engaged."
  )
)

# Aggregate privacy coverage report (strictly zero raw PII stored or printed)
pii_privacy_report(notes, text_col = "note_text")
```

## Step 3: Declare a Strict Typed Extraction Schema

Define the exact R column types, enum levels, numeric bounds, and nullability
rules for downstream statistical analysis:

```{r schema}
clinical_schema <- extraction_schema(
  sentiment = schema_field(
    "enum",
    values = c("positive", "neutral", "negative"),
    description = "Overall emotional tone of the session note"
  ),
  severity = schema_field(
    "integer",
    min = 0L,
    max = 10L,
    description = "Clinical symptom severity rating from 0 to 10"
  ),
  confidence = schema_field(
    "numeric",
    min = 0,
    max = 1,
    nullable = TRUE,
    description = "Model extraction confidence score"
  ),
  crisis_flag = schema_field(
    "logical",
    description = "TRUE if acute safety or crisis risk is indicated"
  ),
  name = "clinical_session_coding"
)
clinical_schema
```

## Step 4: Execute Crash-Resumable, Schema-Enforced Batch Extraction

Now run `airgap_extract()` with:

- Mandatory pre-inference PII redaction (`pii_policy = "redact"`),
- Simulated malformed JSON on `NOTE_02` to demonstrate automatic structured
  repair retries,
- Atomic row-level checkpointing (`checkpoint_path`), and
- Automatic hash-chained IRB/HIPAA audit logging (`audit_log_path`).

In production on a local GPU workstation, swap `runtime_mock()` for
`runtime_ollama("llama3.1:8b-instruct-q4_K_M")` or
`runtime_openai_local("llama-3.1-8b", base_url = "http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1")`.

```{r extract}
ck_path <- tempfile(fileext = ".checkpoint.jsonl")
audit_path <- tempfile(fileext = ".audit.jsonl")

rt <- runtime_mock(
  model = "llama-3.1-8b-instruct-q4_K_M",
  seed = 2026L,
  malform_schedule = list(
    NOTE_02 = c(
      "{truncated_json",
      '{"sentiment":"very_bad","severity":99,"confidence":0.8,"crisis_flag":false}'
    )
  )
)

extracted <- airgap_extract(
  data = notes,
  text_col = "note_text",
  schema = clinical_schema,
  runtime = rt,
  id_col = "note_id",
  pii_policy = "redact",
  checkpoint_path = ck_path,
  audit_log_path = audit_path,
  container_spec = spec,
  model_path = model_file,
  max_retries = 2L
)

extracted
```

Notice that `NOTE_02` succeeded on attempt 3 after two automatic structured
repair retries, and every column has strict R types (`character`, `integer`,
`numeric`, `logical`).

```{r throughput}
extraction_throughput(extracted)
```

## Step 5: Verify the Immutable Audit Log & Generate IRB Boilerplate

Verify cryptographic chain integrity from `GENESIS` to the latest entry, then
render a ready-to-paste Methods / IRB Data-Security protocol section directly
from the verified ledger:

```{r audit-and-irb}
audit_log_verify(audit_path)

irb_text <- generate_irb_narrative(
  source = audit_path,
  study_title = "Offline Clinical Progress Note Phenotyping",
  protocol_id = "IRB-2026-0412",
  institution = "University Research Medical Center",
  regulatory_framework = c("HIPAA", "IRB"),
  format = "markdown"
)

cat(irb_text)
```

```{r cleanup, include = FALSE}
unlink(c(ck_path, audit_path))
unlink(tmp_dir, recursive = TRUE)
```
